title: How I Used AI to Create LOGBOOK: Beneath the Storm (Now on Steam)
author: pink-iceberg-games
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I’m pretty new to Reddit and I somehow missed this community. So let me repair my oversight. I am the solo developer behind **LOGBOOK: Beneath the Storm**, a narrative deduction game inspired by *The Case of the Golden Idol*. Players need to solve 10 murder cases that together reveal a full story.

In *LOGBOOK: Beneath the Storm*, I used AI in several parts of the development process. Before diving into the details, a quick disclaimer: These assets were created nearly a year ago, so models have evolved significantly since then. Keep that in mind when judging the results!

https://i.redd.it/ywnq1sspf9oh1.gif

# Graphical Assets

I used generative AI to help create the game’s visual assets. The most obvious use was for the background images of each scene. It was quite challenging at the time to maintain consistency, and I used a combination of Midjourney paired with ChatGPT for some edits. Each model has its own strengths. 

The main challenges were:

* Keeping recurring characters consistent.
* Getting the AI to generate images of people looking dead for the murder cases.

I didn’t generate the images directly in pixel art. Instead, I chose a style and then post-processed them. The main issue I faced with pixel art was that models didn’t generate consistent-sized pixel images.

The other use of AI for graphical elements was the UI, such as the chapter selection screen and the paper of the different letters.

https://preview.redd.it/66utyevhg9oh1.png?width=616&format=png&auto=webp&s=b91de54386f55e66ee81a5d2385542c955a545d5

# Music

The music was generated using AI, and I’m quite happy with the results. That’s all I have to say about that!

# Coding

I did not vibe coded the game, but LLMs were very useful for helping me learn Godot and during implementation.

If you have any questions about my workflow or the tools I used, don’t hesitate to ask!

I’m truly grateful for AI tools, without them, I wouldn’t have been able to create this game. But there’s a cost when it comes to exposing and marketing the game. How do you deal with that?

It was released last week (September 3rd), and the **10% launch discount is still running** if anyone is interested:

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4407400/LOGBOOK\_Beneath\_the\_Storm/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4407400/LOGBOOK_Beneath_the_Storm/)
